name: B10-0113/2026 (S&D) – World Cancer Day
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on World Cancer Day
part_text:
The European Parliament marks World Cancer Day and calls for action on cancer. It asks the European Commission and member states to keep funding and fully carry out Europe's Beating Cancer Plan through 2028–2034. It wants a dedicated European Union health budget, better access to cancer medicines and cross-border care, more focus on rare, childhood and older patients' cancers, action on risk factors like tobacco and alcohol, and protection for cancer survivors from financial discrimination. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet in law; the Parliament sets out demands for the Commission and member states.
- **Who it affects:** Cancer patients, survivors, families, health workers and researchers across the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and national governments; they decide whether to act.
